Adrienne's Classic Desserts provides an assortment of healthier sweets that everyone can enjoy.  Try these delicious Vegan Caramel Chocolate Chip Cookies.  They are made with decadent, non-dairy caramel chocolate chips, coconut sugar, vegan butter and some other key ingredients.  For more delicious recipes, follow on Instagram @adriennesclassicdesserts.  If you would like to subscribe to my newsletter for other recipes, tap the linktree in my bio.

Vegan Carmel Chocolate Chip Cookies

Ingredients:
1/2 Cup of vegan butter, softened slightly
1 Cup of coconut sugar
3 Tablespoons of organic sugar

My husband started taking a statin in June of last year.

Took his 40mg Lipitor every morning at 7 sharp.

Took the fish oil pills he ordered off the internet.

Cancelled his Friday night steak at the place we'd gone to for thirty years.

Quit eggs entirely.

Went on the Mediterranean diet.

Walked three miles a day.

Started eating oatmeal every morning, of all things.

He did everything the doctor told him.

He died of a massive heart attack on October 25th at 5:23 in the morning.

He was 61 years old.

His cast-iron skillet is still hanging above the stove.

I can't take it down.

Three women brought the exact same Jell-O salad to the same church potluck last Easter, and none of them remembered they had brought it the year before, or the year before that, or the year before that.

It was the orange kind, the one with the can of mandarin oranges drained and folded in and the little marshmallows on top. June Henson made hers in a bundt mold. Carolyn Pickett made hers in a glass casserole dish. Annette Wadsworth made hers in a tupperware that used to be a different color before the dishwasher got to it.
